## Preparation for next class ({{< var week8-tuesday >}})

1. Download the following datasets from the [course's Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1USqhiMLyN8GE05B8WJmHabviJGnmAsLP?usp=share_link) and add them to the `data` directory in your `eds-220-sections` directory:
  
  - `NAIP_SB/NAIP_SB_nir.tif`
  - `NAIP_SB/NAIP_SB_rgb.tif`
  - `SB_aoi.geojson`

2. Download the notebook [`week8-rioxarray-STUDENTS.ipynb`](https://github.com/MEDS-eds-220/student-notebooks/blob/main/week-8-rioxarray-STUDENTS.ipynb) and move it into your `EDS-220/eds220-in-class` directory. 

3. Update the file path in the code cell so it points to your data folder containing the rasters and the geoJSON file. There's nothing to run in this notebook. We'll just use it to have some pre-filled explanations. 
:::
